title: Circuit values satisfy gate clauses
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs in which each gate has at most two arguments, and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. Assign each vertex the value it receives when the circuit is evaluated on $x$. The conjunction of the Tseitin clauses for all gates of $C$ is true under this assignment.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Every gate has at most two arguments
